verdict.rationale: v0 describes itself as an AI agent that builds apps, so it occupies the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows v0 running as an MCP server, such as a serve mode or a hosted MCP endpoint. Its Platform API and SDK are programmatic access, not an MCP server, so they do not make this axis applicable.
